description: About: the institutional argument behind the site. Canonical block content for the six About pages, loaded into WordPress as page content plus the page fields below. Template page-about.php; styles assets/css/about.css. Shortcodes: [summit_about_sequence] (the section's editorial index) and [summit_about_portrait] (a portrait when its file exists in theme/summit/assets/img/about/, a typographic monogram otherwise).

meta.summit_standfirst: Summit is a strategic design and intelligence practice working across luxury, culture, product, experience and institutions.
How client work kept raising questions that brand strategy could not answer — and how the answers became a book, an annual reading, an observatory and a publication.
meta.summit_summary: How client work became a line of inquiry, and the inquiry became an instrument.

meta.summit_standfirst: Six propositions about luxury: stewardship, restraint, authority, memory, governance and judgement.
meta.summit_summary: Six propositions about what luxury requires.

meta.summit_standfirst: Luxury has never had more reach, more data or more ways to produce. The scarce capability is deciding what should exist.
meta.summit_summary: Why the quality of judgement matters more as attention, output and speed become cheap.

meta.summit_standfirst: Summit is deliberately small at its centre. The people who frame a question stay with it, and specialists join where their expertise changes the outcome.
meta.summit_summary: Summit’s leadership, its intellectual collaborators, and how specialists join the work.

meta.summit_standfirst: Summit enters through the problem rather than a pre-sold discipline, and the people who frame the question stay with the work.
